title: GTA-6 scam: a "free download" turns out to be a data thief
content_md:
GTA-6 scam: a "free download" turns out to be a data thief. A supposed free download of Grand Theft Auto VI turns out to be a data-stealing trojan instead of the game. The post covers fake downloads, data theft and cybercrime in the gaming scene.
